name: Get CSRF token
description: Call this when you need a CSRF token to include in a form submission (e.g., posting a company). Use a different form_id parameter for other forms; the same endpoint with a different form_id is the better fit for those cases.

form_id.description: Identifier of the form for which the CSRF token is requested (e.g., "post.company").

token.description: The CSRF token string to be used in subsequent form submissions.
